verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance is API-first by design (account ownership, balance, transaction data, ACH details, webhooks, etc. all exposed via documented endpoints), and there is no separate end-user UI whose functionality would need to be matched — most flows (Connect widget) are meant to be embedded via API/SDK. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm full parity for every UI-exposed configuration (e.g., partner dashboard/admin settings, Connect widget customization options) is achievable purely via API. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all dashboard/admin/configuration actions available in the Mastercard developer portal UI are also exposed via API, and independent/hands-on verification of full API-UI parity.
